correctness.rationale: The full Jordan BV decomposition and Hilbert Jensen reduction identify single-arc maximizing inputs; exact circular autocorrelation integrates the residual for all widths and lengths, with explicit derivatives proving the plateau/unique half-circle branches. Strict nonzero-mode bound for the box Fourier multiplier makes equality rigid for every admissible width. The algebraic cubic-root bandwidth maximizer and endpoints follow from differentiating the closed form. Independent rational and Fourier checks support but do not replace the analytic full-domain proof.

value.rationale: The canonical one-sided circular moving-average residual is analyzed on a natural real BV unit ball with a complete all-window sharp norm and equality classification. The critical width a=1/2 changes a continuum of worst-case step lengths into a uniquely fixed separation, and the sharp residual norm is strictly nonmonotone with unique algebraic worst width. These structural outcomes are meaningful for jump smoothing and are not merely small numerical improvements or arbitrary finite parameter slices.
